# TuinBooks v56.0.4

Cumulative office and mobile application build.

Build token: `56.0.4-operational-usability1`.

This release restores reliable operational cloud saving, removes the account name from the header, simplifies current billing, adds visible Work/catch-up alerts, compacts Work Records, and restores future-week queue placement and duration resizing.

Run the included v56.0.4 Supabase compatibility migration before uploading the app folder.
